name: EPIC 248886017
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 10.3 solar radii and 0.90 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248886017 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.274616 (16th-84th percentiles 9.951707-10.629827), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,922 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.90 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,985 K at its surface.
